gloss: in the blink of an eye; in an instant; in no time

definitions.gloss: in the blink of an eye; in an instant; in no time
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening extremely quickly, in the time it takes to blink. Often used to express surprise at how fast something occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The fire spread in an instant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The new product sold out in no time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{一日一日|いちにちいちにち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: Children grow up in the blink of an eye, so I want to cherish each day.

notes:
Literally 'in the interval of blinking' (⟦{瞬|またた}く→瞬く：04385_matataku⟧ to blink + {間|ま} interval + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The image is that something happens so fast it occurs within a single blink of the eye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread in an instant
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass in a flash
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れる→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧: to sell out instantly
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: to vanish in an instant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧: in no time, before you know it — more colloquial and conversational
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in a moment — emphasizes a single instant
- ⟦たちまち→たちまち：07371_tachimachi⟧: immediately, at once — similar speed but slightly more formal
- ⟦みるみる→みるみる：21458_mirumiru⟧: visibly, rapidly — emphasizes that the change is observable in real time
